b9e8958e810a2cb6.description:
Who We Are
Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.
Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.
The Team
You'll work on three things together: Atlan's context layer, the platforms that make it usable, and the agents that run on top of it.
The platform handles the things agents need to be trusted in production: knowing which agents and skills exist, understanding what happened during a run, evaluating how well they performed, and controlling access and cost.
Then there are the agents themselves. Each one is built to do a specific job, either for our customers or for our own teams. These aren't demos sitting on a slide. We already have an agent our CSMs rely on, three GTM agents that replace around 3,000 manual calls, an agent that watches changes across atlan.com, and an agent that monitors our other agents.
We share what we're learning through Becoming Frontier.
You'll own the frontend, but you won't be limited to the frontend. We use AI heavily in how we build, and we expect you to be comfortable working across the stack.
We work in small "two-slice" teams. You'll typically own an initiative with one or two other people. There's no large team around you to hand work off to, so you'll have a lot of ownership over how something gets built.

What will you do?
• 
Take a 0→1 idea all the way to production. Figure out the problem, write the spec when one doesn't exist, make the architecture decisions and build it.
• 
Own the frontend experience for agents. Build the interfaces people use to find, run, inspect and approve agents. Care about rendering performance and build components that other engineers can build on.
• 
Work beyond the frontend. Use coding agents to navigate unfamiliar backend code, make changes and validate their output rather than blindly trusting what they generate.
• 
Build agents with the people who will actually use them. Demo early, learn from real usage and put the agent into the workflow where the work already happens.
• 
Design for things going wrong. Think through what happens when a tool fails, context is missing, an agent isn't confident or a human needs to take over.
• 
Make agent behavior observable. Connect traces and evals to the version of the agent that produced them, and treat changes in quality as regressions worth investigating.
• 
Build AI-native yourself. Use coding agents as part of your daily workflow, while keeping the engineering and architectural bar high.
• 
Share what you learn. Turn useful patterns into skills, reference architectures and demos that other engineers can build on.

What makes you a great match for us?
Must have
• 
Strong frontend fundamentals. You've shipped production UIs using React, Vue or something similar with TypeScript, and you've dealt with hard problems around rendering performance, component systems or framework migrations.
• 
You've taken 0→1 products from an idea to production, often without a neatly defined spec.
• 
You've shipped agents or LLM-powered systems that real people use, and can debug failures down to the context, tool call or decision that caused them.
• 
You use evals to understand where agents fail and improve them based on real user impact.
• 
You use coding agents regularly and hold their output to the same engineering bar as your own.
• 
You're a critical optimist. You can get excited about new technology without taking it at face value, and you're comfortable reasoning from first principles.
• 
You enjoy owning an initiative with a small number of people rather than working as one part of a large team.
Strong bonus
• 
React, Vite and TypeScript, which is our current stack.
• 
Experience with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks, LLM gateways or agent observability.
• 
Experience as a founding engineer or working at an early-stage startup.
• 
A public trail of work, such as an active GitHub, npm packages or open-source contributions, that gives us a sense of how you build.
This probably isn't for you if...
You want to manage a large team, prefer having a well-defined backlog handed to you, only want to work on the frontend, or are still waiting to start working with AI.
We're looking for someone who wants to build with this technology now.

Why Atlan?
Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:
• 
Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
• 
AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
• 
Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
• 
Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
• 
Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
• 
Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us
Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”
We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

What are we hiring for?

The systems that run millions of businesses.

Every month, 2.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window - with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

Responsibilities:

• 

Build and ship features in Node.js / Go services that sit on real production paths — your code handles live traffic, not toy problems

• 

Own well-scoped services and components end to end: code, tests, rollout, and monitoring

• 

Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores — writing queries, adding indexes, and learning why the schema looks the way it does

• 

Get hands-on with queues, caches, and rate limiters — the building blocks of every system here

• 

Ship Vue 3 UIs that consume your own APIs — clean components, sane state management, and realtime updates that don't flicker or drift

• 

Write design docs for your features and defend them in review — clear thinking, honest trade-offs

• 

Join the on-call rotation with backup from senior engineers — incidents are where the deepest learning happens

• 

Ask questions relentlessly, absorb feedback from code reviews, and level up fast

Requirements:

• 

2+ years of backend engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Node.js, Go, or a comparable language — and the drive to go deep in ours

• 

Working knowledge of queues or async processing — you've used Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar, and want to master delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure

• 

Genuine interest in distributed systems — you understand the basics (idempotency, retries, consistency trade-offs) and are hungry to learn the rest by building

• 

Hands-on with Redis or another cache/in-memory store, even at small scale

• 

Comfortable with SQL or NoSQL databases — you can model data, write efficient queries, and reason about indexes

• 

Proficient in Vue 3 or a similar modern frontend framework — solid component design and real experience with state management (Pinia, Vuex, or equivalent)

• 

You write tests as a habit and can put your design thinking into a clear doc

• 

AI-native builder — you code with agents daily and are pushing to get accurate, production-quality output from them

Technical Environment:

• 

Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go

• 

Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Tailwind

• 

Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse

• 

Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks

• 

CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

Why This Role

Most engineers spend years at companies where "scale" means a few hundred requests per second — and never find out what they're capable of.

Here, the systems are the teacher. Every design decision has a visible consequence at billions of events a month. Every incident is a masterclass. You'll sit in architecture reviews with staff engineers debating storage engines and consistency models — and within a year, you'll be contributing to those debates, not just watching them.

If you optimize your career for learning velocity, there is no faster track than this.

On AI

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build - and we expect you to be hungry for it.

You already code with agents daily. You're learning what they're good at, where they hallucinate, and how to get accurate, tested, slop-free code out of them fast. You treat AI as a multiplier on your learning speed, not a substitute for understanding.

If you're still copy-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.

What you're built for

• 

You're deeply curious — you don't stop at "it works," you need to know why it works

• 

You read post-mortems and system-design write-ups for fun, not because someone assigned them

• 

You've built things beyond your job description — side projects, internal tools, that one system you rewrote because the old one bothered you

• 

You take feedback like a gift: code review comments make your next PR better, every time

• 

When something breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

What Success looks like

• 

You own a service or component that the team trusts you on completely

• 

You're a dependable on-call engineer — you've debugged real incidents and shipped the fixes

• 

Your design docs have gone from "reviewed heavily" to "approved with nits"

• 

Senior engineers pull you into harder problems — because you've earned it

• 

You're visibly on the path to SDE-3, and everyone around you knows it

Bonus Points

• 

Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

• 

You've contributed to a messaging, automation, or event-driven system — at any scale

• 

Side projects or open-source work that shows you build because you can't not build

About HappyRobot
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.
Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.
This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.
Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.
This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile
• 
Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.
• 
Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.
• 
Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.
• 
Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.
• 
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have
• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
• 
Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.
• 
Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.
• 
Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.
• 
Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?
• 
Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
• 
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
• 
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
• 
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
• 
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
 
Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
 
Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
 
We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
 
Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
 
Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.
 
First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. 

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

• Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against

• Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current

• Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey

• Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution

• Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership

• Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments

• Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale

• Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution

Sales Enablement & Sales Plays

• Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases.

• Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling).

• Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions

• Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments

Analyst & Review Site Strategy

• Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).

• Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.

• Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization

• Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings

Website & CRO Performance

• Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide

• Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance

• Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows

• Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data

Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.

• Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership

• Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration

• Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.

• Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.

• Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.

• Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment.

• Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.

• Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy.

• Exceptional communication skills and executive presence.

• Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence.

• Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.
